player_prompt.intro:
O tshwara Player {player_id} o tla tshwara pereko ya Checkers e le {color}.
Kenya tshepele ya gago ka tsela ya chess-style notation [fileRank fileRank], e.g. '[b2c3]' (leterata la kolona a–h, digit ya setsi 0–7).
Mekata ya tshepele:
  • Tshepele ka tsela ya diagonal forward ke 1 ha e se tsene.
  • Tshepele ka tsela ya go tsena ka go tsamaya kantle le piece ya motho wa ntle.
  • Piece e na e ba King ha e fihlela setsiwa sa motho wa ntle.

invalid_move.wrong_format: Ga go na tsela ya tsamaya e e nepagetšego. Šomiša [a1b2], mohl. [b2c3].

outcome.red_no_pieces: Mmala o mogweu ga o na masweu. Mmala o mosweu o thabile!
outcome.black_no_pieces: Ba baso ga ba sa na dibetša. Bohubedu bo a fenya!
outcome.no_moves: Sebapadi {player_id} ga se sa na mothaladi o mongwe.
outcome.draw: Moedi wa go retologa o fihlilwe.
